configuration.fitting: exact sibling predict_all; canonical Backbone unchanged; resolved strictly before target opens
configuration.interval: two-sided Student t 95% interval across 20 independent world means, descriptive finite generator support
configuration.matched_donor: fixed random writer derangement, equal opportunity/history length
configuration.null_rule: both own-minus-comparator gain upper bounds <= 0.005 in uninformative and constant conditions
configuration.positive_rule: both planted mean gain lower bounds > 0.005 against baseline and donor
configuration.score: mean paired half-Brier gain per independent world; all chronological targets included
configuration.severity: independent world draws: signal strength, type/action mapping, hash collisions, nuisance words, task context, resolution delays and writer order
configuration.structural_rule: constant own/donor predictions equal <=1e-12; future-label prefix and option-row-equivariance differences <=1e-7; exact strict train-ID sets; finite normalized probabilities

limitations: Four-decision constructed support does not exercise later personal-penalty calibration.
Human-data mapping and exposed-holdout approval remain Sounding Line responsibilities.
